info.title: Merchant Hosted — Cross-Border Cards
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.1 for PayU merchant-hosted **`POST /_payment`** in the Cross-Border Cards server-to-server (S2S) flow.

Post `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` fields from your server. Set **`pg`** to **CC** and **`bankcode`** to **CC** for card payments. Build **`hash`** on your server per PayU rules.

Confirm sandbox keys, hash sequence, and CB field requirements with your PayU Key Account Manager (KAM).

post.description: Merchant-hosted card payment via the Cross-Border Cards S2S flow. This operation documents the complete-card request schema.

requestBody.description: Form-encoded payment request. All S2S and billing fields marked required apply to the Cross-Border Cards flow.

key.description: Merchant key provided by PayU during onboarding.

txnid.description: The transaction ID is a reference number for a specific order that is generated by the merchant.

amount.description: The payment amount for the transaction. Post as a decimal string (for example, "1000" or "10.00").

productinfo.description: A brief description of the product.

firstname.description: The first name of the customer.

surl.description: The success URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is successful.

furl.description: The failure URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction fails.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

pg.description: The pg parameter determines which payment tabs will be displayed on the PayU page. For cards, use CC.

ccnum.description: Use 13-19 digit card number for credit/debit cards (15 digits for AMEX, 13-19 for Maestro) and validate with LUHN algorithm. Use only test cards as in the example or that is listed in Test Cards, UPI ID and Wallets section.

ccvv.description: Use 3-digit CVV number for credit/debit cards and 4-digit security code (4DBC/CID) for AMEX cards. Validate with BIN API.

ccname.description: Name on card as entered by the customer for the transaction.

ccexpmon.description: Card expiry month in MM format. For months 1-9, use 01, 02, … 09. For months 10-12, use 10, 11, or 12.

ccexpyr.description: Card expiry year in four digits. Use 2025 in this field for the test environment.

hash.description: Hash calculated by the merchant. Format: sha512(key|txnid|amount|productinfo|firstname|email|udf1|udf2|udf3|udf4|udf5||||||SALT)

phone.description: The phone number of the customer.

lastname.description: The last name of the customer.

buyer_type_business.description: Identifies a B2B transaction. Post 1 for B2B.

curl.description: The cancel URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is cancelled by the customer.

udf1.description: This parameter is optional but recommended for a higher approval rate. Buyer PAN (Permanent Account Number) for Cross-Border flows. Character limit: 10 alphanumeric.

udf3.description: This parameter is optional but recommended for a higher approval rate. Buyer date of birth (DOB) in DD-MM-YYYY format for Cross-Border flows.

udf4.description: Merchant name for PA2PA integrations. Do not pass for UPI mandate or recurring transactions.

udf5.description: Invoice ID for the merchant. Mandatory during or after the transaction (including via the udf_update API post successful transaction).

address1.description: This parameter is optional but recommended for a higher approval rate. The customer's primary billing address line (up to 100 characters).

address2.description: The customer's secondary billing address line. Optional.

city.description: This parameter is optional but recommended for a higher approval rate. The customer's billing city (maximum 50 characters).

state.description: This parameter is optional but recommended for a higher approval rate. The customer's billing state or province (maximum 50 characters).

country.description: This parameter is optional but recommended for a higher approval rate. The customer's billing country code. Use ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (maximum 50 characters).

zipcode.description: The customer's billing postal/zip code. Mandatory for Cross-Border Cards; use a 6-digit India zipcode where applicable.

txn_s2s_flow.description: Enables the S2S flow. Mandatory for S2S; set to 4 for S2S4 flow.

s2s_client_ip.description: Client IP captured by the merchant in the S2S flow. Mandatory for fraud detection.

s2s_device_info.description: User agent captured by the merchant in the S2S flow. Mandatory for the S2S flow.

udf_params.description: Optional JSON string for additional UDF values; documents UDF7 for Import or Export Code and UDF8 for Airway Bill / Consignment Number.

200.description: May return HTML or a query-string style body (for example, mihpayid=…&status=success&…) depending on integration. Verify hash on return using PayU post-response hash rules.

302.description: Redirect to issuer / ACS / bank or merchant surl / furl (typical browser flow).

bankcode.description: Each payment option is identified with a unique bank code at PayU. For cards, post CC.

tags.name: Cross-Border Cards
tags.description: Merchant-hosted card payments for Cross-Border integrations using the S2S flow.
